Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
I am afraid the last 3d of the [Primer](../books.html#353) is lost. I will re write it after my outing.

Happily it is only 40 pp at most - I hope waiting will not be troublesome.

Here is another instalment of '[The Story of the Christians and Moors in Spain](../books.html#126)'

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
